title: Encoding membership and perfect matchings
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix. The encoded pair consisting of a word of $n$ ones and the row-by-row list of entries of $A$ belongs to the language of encoded bipartite graphs with perfect matchings if and only if the bipartite graph associated with $A$ has a perfect matching.
